differs: Value 1: silicon resets the block and (per the register being "set and reset by software") keeps it in reset while the bit is 1, so an access to it while the bit is 1 would meet a block in reset; the twin runs Reset() once at the write and then lets the live peripheral take accesses with the bit still 1.
